nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; controls delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress and is used as whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances; mutated directly without SafeMath in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance used for spender approvals; modified unbounded in transferFrom and approve.
mapping(address=>bool) canSale flag; when true for an account it bypasses condition() checks in ensure().
tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure(); writable by owner through setTradeAddress.
mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum counting sales per sender; used by condition() to cap sales.
uint256 _saleNum maximum per-address sale count; configured by init().
uint256 _minSale minimum transfer value enforced in condition(); configured by init().
uint256 _maxSale maximum transfer value enforced in condition(); configured by init().
Public totalSupply set in the constructor from the owner-supplied _supply value.
Hardcoded constant router address 0x7a25...488D whitelisted in ensure() and granted infinite allowance in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal whitelist gate: returns true for owner, UNI, computed pair or canSale accounts, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without restriction.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits and per-address _onSaleNum cap; victim of sale-throttle logic.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker/owner supplied address and calldata.
Backdoor mint permitting owner OR a hardcoded address to overwrite arbitrary balanceOf and set canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum used by condition().
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked multiplication of _value*_tos.length.
Owner-only setter writing the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256/create2, used by ensure() to whitelist the pool.
Payable constructor assigning name, symbol, totalSupply, owner=msg.sender, balances and infinite UNI allowance.
msg.sender: primary untrusted caller identity used for access control checks, allowances and balance updates.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate(): executes untrusted code in the storage context of this contract.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, susceptible to arithmetic overflow.
Unchecked multiplication balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) in _mints, allowing mint of arbitrary amounts.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn performing external token calls.
Parameter _to (transfer/transferFrom recipient).
Parameter _value (transfer/transferFrom amount).
Parameter _from (transferFrom source account).
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Parameter a: delegatecall target address in delegate().
Parameter b: delegatecall calldata bytes in delegate().
Parameter addedValue: minted amount in _mints.
Parameter spender: account whose balance and canSale flag are written in _mints.
Local _UNI computed pair address inside ensure().
Parameter addr: new tradeAddress value in setTradeAddress.
Parameter saleNum configuring _saleNum in init().
Parameter token configuring _minSale in init().
Parameter maxToken configuring _maxSale in init().
Private SafeERC20 helper that verifies the target is a contract and performs the low-level token call.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
msg.sender is used for the allowance check and allowance decrement inside transferFrom().
delegate() gate require(msg.sender==owner) depends on the untrusted caller identity.
_mints() authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hardcoded address, acting as a backdoor mint gate.
init() restricts configuration to msg.sender==owner.
batchSend() restricts execution to msg.sender==owner.
setTradeAddress() restricts writing the whitelist to msg.sender==owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the untrusted caller address.
delegate() transfers control to the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
The delegatecall executes in this contract's context and can overwrite the owner slot, enabling ownership takeover.
_mints() reaches the unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**decimals).
The unchecked minted value is written directly into balanceOf[spender].
_mints() lets the backdoor caller overwrite the victim balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary value.
_mints() sets canSale[spender]=true, bypassing the ensure()/condition() sale restrictions.
batchSend() computes total with an unchecked multiplication of _value and array length.
The overflowable total is subtracted from and added into balanceOf entries.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor().
ensure() returns true immediately when _from or _to equals the owner address, granting a whitelist bypass.
ensure() consults the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] to allow restricted transfers.
transferFrom() decrements the sender and increments the recipient balanceOf entries.
transferFrom() checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer value.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer value.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale cap.
init() writes _minSale from owner-supplied token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from owner-supplied maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the owner-supplied saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress() writes the privileged tradeAddress whitelist slot.
The constructor sets owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
msg.sender becomes the owner during construction, granting unlimited mint/allowance powers.
approve() writes the allowance mapping without an upper bound.
callOptionalReturn() performs the low-level external token call.
transfer() recipient parameter flows into the transferFrom call.
transfer() amount parameter flows into the transferFrom call.
transferFrom() source parameter drives allowance/balance/branch logic.
transferFrom() amount parameter drives allowance, balance and condition checks.
local total carries the overflowable product into the balance arithmetic of batchSend().
delegate() target address parameter is used directly as the delegatecall destination.
delegate() calldata parameter is used directly as the delegatecall payload.
_mints() mint amount parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication.
_mints() spender parameter selects the arbitrary account whose balance and canSale flag are overwritten.
local _UNI carries the computed pair address into the ensure() whitelist comparison.
setTradeAddress() addr parameter is written into the privileged whitelist slot.
init() saleNum parameter configures the sale cap used by condition().
init() token parameter configures the minimum sale value.
init() maxToken parameter configures the maximum sale value.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient recipient parameter of transferFrom/transfer used only to update balanceOf[recipient]; merge into the transferFrom core function.
_value is a transient amount parameter consumed by the allowance, balance and condition logic of transferFrom; merge into the transferFrom core function.
_from is a transient source parameter driving allowance checks and _onSaleNum updates in transferFrom; merge into the transferFrom core function.
local total is a temporary product inside batchSend that immediately feeds balance subtraction; merge into the batchSend core function.
parameter a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate(); merge into the delegate core function.
parameter b is only used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate(); merge into the delegate core function.
addedValue is only used in the unchecked mint multiplication inside _mints; merge into the _mints core function.
spender only selects the account overwritten in balanceOf and canSale inside _mints; merge into the _mints core function.
local _UNI is a temporary pair address computed for the ensure() whitelist check; merge into the ensure core function.
addr is only stored into the tradeAddress whitelist by setTradeAddress(); merge into the setTradeAddress core function.
saleNum is only written into _saleNum by init(); merge into the init core function.
token is only written into _minSale by init(); merge into the init core function.
maxToken is only written into _maxSale by init(); merge into the init core function.
